title.heading:
Programming
a KST servo
title.text:
Plug in, connect, edit, write.
8 steps on the bench's touch screen.

labels.title: rbmod carrier
labels.text: RP2350 IOmcu board. Its headers J1 and J2 face the case wall.

labels.title: PD mini
labels.text: Adjustable supply for the servo outputs on J2.

labels.title: Display and panel
labels.text: 7 inch touch screen, 1024 x 600, on the ESP32-P4.

labels.title: PROG ports
labels.text: PROGP01 to PROGP04. Fixed 5 V, switched by the bench. KST servos are programmed here.

labels.title: J2 · servo outputs
labels.text: PWM01 to PWM04. Not used for programming.

labels.title: Plug in one servo
labels.text: One servo on one position. GND wire at the top, towards the display. Signal wire at the bottom.

pinout.subtitle: Seen from outside the case, display up

say.text: This video shows how the R C bench reads and writes the settings of a K S T servo, on a bench with the R B mod carrier.
The carrier sits under the display.
Its header J 1 holds the four programming ports. The bench switches their 5 volts.
Step 1. Plug the servo into one position, with the ground wire at the top, towards the display.

steps.title: Open the KST programmer
steps.text: On the SERVO hub, tap KST.
steps.say: Step 2. On the servo hub, tap K S T.

steps.title: Choose the port
steps.text: Tap PORT on the READY card.
steps.say: Step 3. Tap port on the ready card.

steps.title: Choose the port
steps.text: Pick the position the servo is plugged into: PROGP01 to PROGP04.
steps.say: Pick the position the servo is plugged into.

steps.title: The port and its supply
steps.text: The head names the port, PROG PORT 1 GPIO 13, and its supply, 5V FIXED. The carrier makes that 5V from its 15V input: under 13.5V the bench refuses CONNECT.
steps.say: The head of the tab names the port and its supply, 5 volts fixed. The carrier makes them from its 15 volt input. With an input under 13.5 volts, the bench refuses connect.

steps.title: KST EXPERT MODE
steps.text: This video shows the programmer with KST EXPERT MODE on. OPTIONS opens its row; a 2s hold switches it on. With it off, the LOCKED tab and the rows DEAD BAND, BOOST and STRETCH are hidden.
steps.say: This video shows the programmer with K S T expert mode on. Options opens its row, and a two second hold switches it on. With it off, which is the default, the locked tab and three rows of tune are hidden.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Hold CONNECT for 2s. The button fades from green to red.
steps.say: Hold connect for two seconds. The button fades from green to red.

steps.title: The power-up
steps.text: The bench switches the ports' 5V off for 1s, then on. A KST servo enters programming mode only after a power-up.
steps.say: The bench switches the ports' 5 volts off for one second, then on. A K S T servo enters programming mode only after a power-up.

steps.title: Reading the servo
steps.text: The port is out of PWM. The bench reads the servo's 32 registers. ABORT stops the read.
steps.say: The port is out of P W M, and the bench reads the 32 registers of the servo.

steps.title: The type is a guess
steps.text: V6? is a suggestion from one register. The servo's label names the type.
steps.say: Step 4. All 32 registers are read. The type, V 6 with a question mark, is a suggestion from one register. The servo's label names the type.

steps.title: Set the servo type
steps.text: Tap TYPE.
steps.say: Tap type.

steps.title: Set the servo type
steps.text: Pick V6 or V8, as on the servo's label.
steps.say: Pick V 6 or V 8, as on the servo's label.

steps.title: The type is set
steps.text: The tab reads Servo type V6, selected under TYPE.
steps.say: The type is set.

steps.title: The tabs
steps.text: TUNE, PULSE and FAILSAFE hold the settings. PULSE: the neutral, the pulse range, both angles and the reversion.
steps.say: Step 5. The settings are on the tabs tune, pulse and failsafe. Pulse holds the neutral, the pulse range, both angles and the reversion.

steps.title: FAILSAFE
steps.text: Tap FAILSAFE.
steps.say: Tap failsafe.

steps.title: FAILSAFE
steps.text: MOVE ON SIGNAL LOSS, the POSITION and the time AFTER which the servo moves there.
steps.say: Failsafe holds the move on signal loss, its position, and the time after which the servo moves there.

steps.title: LOCKED
steps.text: Tap LOCKED.
steps.say: Tap locked.

steps.title: LOCKED
steps.text: Shown with KST EXPERT MODE on: registers whose function or data format is not confirmed. Display only.
steps.say: Locked shows registers whose function or data format is not confirmed. They are display only.

steps.title: TUNE
steps.text: Tap TUNE.
steps.say: Step 6. To change a value, tap tune.

steps.title: Edit a value
steps.text: A tap on a value opens a keypad or a list. - and + step DEAD BAND.
steps.say: A tap on a value opens a keypad or a list. Minus and plus step the dead band.

steps.title: Three edits
steps.text: DEAD BAND 2.0 to 1.6us, BOOST 300.0 to 262.5us, SOFT START ON to OFF.
steps.say: Here three values are edited: the dead band, the boost and the soft start.

steps.title: Marked, not written
steps.text: A * and the accent fill mark a value that differs from the servo's. The footer reads WRITE 3 VALUES. Nothing has reached the servo.
steps.say: A star and the bright fill mark a value that differs from the servo's, and the footer counts three values to write. Nothing has reached the servo yet.

steps.title: Back to SERVO
steps.text: Tap the SERVO tab.
steps.say: Step 7. Tap the servo tab.

steps.title: Hold to write
steps.text: Hold WRITE 3 VALUES for 2s. The hold is the consent: no other switch enables the write.
steps.say: Hold write 3 values for two seconds. The hold is the consent. No other switch enables the write.

steps.title: Hold to write
steps.text: The button fades from green to amber.
steps.say: The button fades from green to amber.

steps.title: Writing
steps.text: The servo's values as read are in the backup file KST001 on the card. Do not unplug the servo or the bench while writing.
steps.say: Before the first write of a session, the bench saves the values it read in a backup file on the card. Then it writes. Do not unplug the servo or the bench meanwhile.

steps.title: Written and verified
steps.text: 3 values written and verified. They take effect after the servo's next power-up.
steps.say: Three values are written and verified. A K S T servo acts on them from its next power-up.

steps.title: Leave
steps.text: Tap LEAVE.
steps.say: Step 8. Tap leave.

steps.title: Leave programming
steps.text: Hold HOLD 2s TO LEAVE for 2s. The bench switches the 5V off for 1s, then on. The servo then receives the tester's signal and may move.
steps.say: Hold for two seconds to leave. The bench switches the 5 volts off for one second, then on. The servo then receives the tester's signal and may move.

steps.title: Done
steps.text: The port is back in tester mode. The written values act.
steps.say: The port is back in tester mode, and the written values act.

scenes.heading: KST servo programmed
scenes.say: The servo holds its new values, and the card holds the values it had before.
